name: Dining tonight
summary: Tonight's dining hall menu drawn as a cafeteria tray with a dish in each compartment; members thumb dishes as they eat, each dish glows warm when tonight's batch is good and greys out when it isn't, the best one wears what people are saying about it, and the verdict says stay or walk to the other hall.
useWhen: is hollis good tonight or should i walk to larkin
whats good at the dining hall rn
dontUseWhen: picking a restaurant off campus (use dinner-veto or claw-pick)

other.description: Where to walk instead if it's bad, e.g. 'Larkin'

sub.description: Line under the title: the group and the hours

up.description: Thumbs up already from the group

down.description: Thumbs down already from the group

said.description: What someone said about tonight's batch, in their words
